# appdynamics_action_suppressions (Data Source)

Lists the action suppressions defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_action_suppressions" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "action_suppression_names" {
  value = { for as in data.appdynamics_action_suppressions.all.action_suppressions : as.id => as.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list action suppressions for.

### Read-Only

- `action_suppressions` (Attributes List) The action suppressions defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action_suppressions))

<a id="nestedatt--action_suppressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action_suppressions`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (String)
- `id` (String) Action suppression ID.
- `name` (String)
- `start_time` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
